/** Owner/product API payload shapes; runtime scope and authorization remain server responsibilities. @module */
export interface Project {
  id: number
  name: string
  description?: string
  status: 'new' | 'planning' | 'executing' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'failed'
  created_at?: string
  updated_at?: string
  completed_at?: string
  task_counts?: Record<string, number>
  total_tasks?: number
  total_epics?: number
}

export interface Epic {
  /** Creation receipts identify the original request; list reads do not imply one. */
  operation_key?: string | null
  id: number
  project_id: number
  title: string
  description?: string
  status: 'open' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'cancelled'
  priority: number
  created_by?: string
  created_at?: string
  updated_at?: string
  task_count?: number
  tasks_done?: number
  milestone_count?: number
}

export interface Milestone {
  /** Original creation identity is checked before a retained request is cleared. */
  operation_key?: string | null
  id: number
  project_id: number
  epic_id: number
  title: string
  description?: string
  status: 'open' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'cancelled'
  due_date?: string
  created_at?: string
  updated_at?: string
  task_count?: number
  tasks_done?: number
}

export interface Task {
  operation_key?: string | null
  id: number
  project_id: number
  epic_id?: number
  milestone_id?: number
  type: 'code' | 'research' | 'investigation' | 'review' | 'test' | 'design' | 'integrate' | 'documentation' | 'bug_fix' | 'plan' | 'experimentation' | 'optimization'
  status: 'backlog' | 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'review_ready' | 'rejected' | 'done'
  title: string
  description?: string
  priority?: number
  estimated_complexity?: string
  assigned_to?: string
  reviewer?: string
  branch_name?: string
  created_by?: string
  created_at?: string
  updated_at?: string
  completed_at?: string
  retry_count?: number
}

export interface TaskComment {
  id: number
  task_id: number
  author: string
  comment_type: 'comment' | 'change_request' | 'approval'
  content: string
  created_at?: string
}

export interface TaskDependency {
  task_id: number
  depends_on_task_id: number
  dependency_type: 'blocks' | 'related_to' | 'parent_of' | 'depends_on'
}

/** Canonical peer provenance: a receipt never certifies understanding or work authorization. */
export interface PeerMessageReceipt {
  message_id: number
  parent_message_id: number | null
  sender_run_id: string
  sender_attempt_id: string
  sender_task_id: number
  sender_context_version: number
  recipient_run_id: string
  recipient_task_id: number
  recipient_context_version: number
  recipient_context_current: boolean
  recipient_status: string
  intent: 'note' | 'question' | 'answer'
  body_sha256: string
  delivery: 'recorded' | 'receipt_acknowledged'
  acknowledged_by_attempt: string | null
  acknowledged_at: number | null
  observations: string[]
  assumptions: string[]
  evidence_refs: {source_id:number;sha256:string}[]
  authorizes_work: false
  understood: 'not_verified'
  applied: 'not_verified'
}

/** Owner conversation row, optionally linked to native work or a distinct advisory peer receipt. */
export interface ChatMessage {
  id: number
  project_id: number
  thread_id?: string
  from_agent: string
  to_agent?: string
  to_role?: string
  message: string
  conversation_type: string
  created_at?: string
  runtime_run_id?: string | null
  runtime_status?: string | null
  context_version?: number | null
  task_id?: number | null
  delivery?: 'recorded' | 'instruction_admitted' | 'proposal' | 'question' | 'answer'
  peer_message?: PeerMessageReceipt | null
}

export interface ChatThread {
  thread_id: string
  project_id: number
  thread_type?: string
  created_at?: string
  last_message?: string
  message_count?: number
}

/** Wiki scope is explicit; a global page never masquerades as a project document. */
export type WikiNamespace = 'project' | 'global'

/** Current page identity/revision/hash; index reads omit content and embeddings. */
export interface WikiPage {
  id: number
  project_id: number | null
  namespace: WikiNamespace
  path: string
  title: string
  content?: string | null
  parent_path?: string | null
  created_by?: string | null
  updated_by?: string | null
  created_at?: string | null
  updated_at?: string | null
  revision: number
  sha256: string
  total_chars?: number | null
  offset?: number | null
  next_offset?: number | null
}

/** Retained wiki text is a named version, not proof of current-page state or validity. */
export interface WikiRevision {
  page_id: number
  project_id: number | null
  namespace: WikiNamespace
  revision: number
  path: string
  title: string
  content: string
  sha256: string
  actor: string | null
  origin: 'legacy_snapshot' | 'adapter_write'
  recorded_at: string | null
  offset?: number
  total_chars?: number
  next_offset?: number | null
}

/** Legacy lexical result identifies its scope/revision; it is not semantic confidence. */
export interface WikiSearchResult {
  id: number
  path: string
  title: string
  namespace: WikiNamespace
  revision: number
  snippet?: string | null
  updated_at?: string | null
}

/** Stored attachment metadata; existence alone does not prove reading or source capture. */
export interface ReferenceFile {
  id: number
  project_id: number
  filename: string
  filepath?: string
  file_size?: number
  mime_type?: string
  description?: string
  uploaded_at?: string
}

export interface EpicProgress {
  id: number
  title: string
  total: number
  done: number
  pct: number
}

export interface BlockingTaskInfo {
  id: number
  title: string
  status: string
}

export interface BlockedTask {
  id: number
  title: string
  status: string
  blocked_by: BlockingTaskInfo[]
}

export interface ProjectProgress {
  total_tasks: number
  done: number
  in_progress: number
  blocked: number
  blocked_tasks: BlockedTask[]
  completion_pct: number
  by_status: Record<string, number>
  epic_progress: EpicProgress[]
  milestone_progress: EpicProgress[]
}

export interface AgentCurrentRun {
  agent_run_id: string
  task_id: number
  task_title?: string
  started_at?: string
}

export interface AgentPerformance {
  successful_runs: number
  failed_runs: number
  total_tokens: number
  total_cost_usd: number
  avg_task_duration_s?: number
}

export interface Agent {
  agent_id: string
  name: string
  role: string
  status: 'idle' | 'active' | 'retired'
  total_runs: number
  created_at?: string
  last_active_at?: string
  current_run?: AgentCurrentRun
  performance?: AgentPerformance
}

export interface UserRequest {
  id: number
  project_id: number
  agent_id?: string
  agent_run_id?: string
  request_type: string
  title: string
  body: string
  options_json: string
  status: 'pending' | 'responded' | 'expired'
  response?: string
  created_at?: string
  responded_at?: string
}

export interface WSEvent {
  event_id?: string
  type: string
  project_id: number
  entity_type?: string
  entity_id?: number
  data?: any
  timestamp?: string
}

export interface AgentActivityEvent {
  id: string
  type: string
  timestamp: string
  from_agent?: string
  to_agent?: string
  to_role?: string
  content?: string
  kind?: string
  entity_id?: number
  task_title?: string
  branch_name?: string
}

export interface Repository {
  id: number
  project_id: number
  name: string
  local_path: string
  remote_url?: string
  default_branch: string
  status: string
  created_at?: string
}

export interface BranchDetail {
  name: string
  last_commit_sha?: string
  last_commit_message?: string
  last_commit_date?: string
  committer_name?: string
}

export interface PullRequest {
  id: number
  repo_id?: number | null
  project_id?: number
  task_id?: number
  branch: string
  repo_name: string
  summary?: string
  status: string
  reviewer?: string
  comments?: string
  forgejo_pr_index?: number
  created_at?: string
  reviewed_at?: string
}

export interface PRComment {
  id: number
  author: string
  body: string
  created_at: string
  html_url?: string
}

export interface RepoTreeEntry {
  path: string
  type: 'blob' | 'tree'
  sha: string
  size?: number
}

export interface FileContent {
  path: string
  content: string
  sha: string
  size: number
  html_url?: string
}

/** Current finding metadata; historical declarations are separate from independent review. */
export interface Finding {
  id: number; project_id: number; task_id: number | null; topic: string
  agent_id: string | null; created_at: string | null; status: string | null
  finding_type: string | null; confidence: number | null; scientific_confidence: number | null
  confidence_origin: string; review_status: string; validation_method: string | null
  legacy_review_status?: string
  /** Presence is stored provenance, never a currentness check or scientific acceptance. */
  review?: {latest_request_id:number;latest_decision_request_id:number|null;status:string;currentness:'not_checked'} | null
  reproducibility_score: number | null; content_chars: number; content_excerpt: string
  evidence_count: number; confidence_invalid?: boolean; confidence_original?: string
}

/** Exact saved quotation relationship, with missing/inconsistent legacy records made explicit. */
export interface FindingEvidence {
  finding_id: number; source_id: number; quote: string; quote_chars: number
  quote_is_exact: boolean; quote_offset: number | null; quote_truncated: boolean
  source_unavailable: boolean; kind: string | null; locator: string | null
  title: string | null; sha256: string | null; captured_at: number | null
  finding_status: string | null
}

/** Independently paged citations never imply that omitted records were examined. */
export interface FindingCitations {
  project_id: number; finding_id: number; evidence: FindingEvidence[]
  total_evidence: number; evidence_offset: number; next_evidence_offset: number | null
}

/** One current body window, rather than an invented retained revision. */
export interface FindingDetail extends Finding, FindingCitations {
  content: string; total_chars: number; offset: number; next_offset: number | null
  legacy_sources_json: string | null; legacy_sources_total_chars: number
  legacy_sources_next_offset: number | null
}

/** Historical raw declarations are preserved but never treated as verified captured citations. */
export interface FindingLegacySources {
  project_id:number;finding_id:number;content:string;total_chars:number;offset:number
  next_offset:number|null;verification:'unverified_legacy_declaration'
}

/** Stable metadata cursor and full matching count for an explicit project/filter set. */
export interface FindingIndex {
  project_id: number; items: Finding[]; total_matching: number; next_after_id: number | null
}

/** Complete bounded local retrieval result; scores describe chunks, not scientific confidence. */
export interface FindingRanking {
  project_id: number; corpus_count: number; finding_ids: number[]; corpus_sha256?: string; record_set_sha256?: string
  search_kind: string; scientific_confidence: null; full_coverage: boolean; next_rank: number | null
  matches: {finding_id:number;topic:string;excerpt:string;score:number;rank:number;record_sha256:string}[]
}

/** Read only a captured source linked to the selected finding; this is not a live fetch. */
export interface FindingSource {
  project_id:number; finding_id:number; source_id:number; kind:string; title:string
  locator:string; sha256:string; captured_at:number; provenance:Record<string,unknown>
  content:string; offset:number; total_chars:number; next_offset:number|null
}

/** Exact historical owner decision; matching bytes alone do not establish current task/context validity. */
export interface ArtifactOwnerAcceptance {
  run_id: string
  task_id: number
  context_version: number
  accepted_at: number
  report_sha256: string
  validity: 'not_rechecked'
  matches_current_content: boolean | null
}

export interface Artifact {
  id: number
  project_id?: number
  task_id?: number
  type: string
  file_path: string
  title?: string | null
  research_status?: 'draft' | 'accepted' | 'superseded' | null
  owner_acceptance?: ArtifactOwnerAcceptance | null
  description?: string
  content?: string
  created_at?: string
}

/** Exact citation plus captured-source identity; capture time is not a freshness check. */
export interface ArtifactEvidence {
  finding_id: number
  source_id: number
  quote: string
  kind: string
  locator: string
  title: string
  sha256: string
  captured_at: number
  finding_status: string
}

/** One project-scoped citation page; a null next_offset means the final page. */
export interface ArtifactEvidencePage {
  artifact_id: number
  project_id: number
  content_sha256: string | null
  evidence: ArtifactEvidence[]
  total_evidence: number
  offset: number
  next_offset: number | null
}

export interface FlowState {
  flow_name: string | null
  current_step: string | null
  subflow_name: string | null
  subflow_step: string | null
  state_summary: Record<string, unknown> | null
  updated_at: string | null
}
